name: Breaking China Stone With Water-Powered Trip Hammers
summary: This painting is from a set of 24 depicting the porcelain industry in China. It shows men breaking china stone with water-powered trip hammers. Europe could not produce true porcelain before the 18th century. Artists targeted paintings such this at Europeans eager to find out the secrets of porcelai

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
